theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_gc_tube_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∀ (a x : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} < r → ∃ e : Fin (m + 2) → Fin P, Function.Injective e ∧ ∃ z : Fin (m + 2) → ℤ, ∑ k, (x (e k) - a (e k) - z k) ^ 2 < r ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
